records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating revenue decreased $1.1 million (0.7%), to $151.3 million for the three months ended March 31, 2022 from $152.4 million for the three months ended March 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Throughout 2021, freight demand was strong and we were able to capitalize on rising freight rates and better utilization across our operating fleet.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Because of these limitations, operating revenue excluding fuel surcharge revenue and adjusted operating ratio should not be considered measures of income generated by our business or discretionary cash available to us to invest in the growth of our business.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Average prices for diesel fuel steadily increased since during 2021 and into 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our cash flow from operating activities for the three months ended March 31, 2022 of $37.6 million was 24.9% of operating revenues, compared to $35.4 million and 23.2% in the same period of 2021.
